text_block_list.text:
I spot Hishi Amazon and Fuji Kiseki
spending their
lunch break at the
cafeteria, so I head over to
join them.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
My, my, aren't you a hearty eater. Isn't
that your
fourth slice of cake?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I've gotta fill up 'cause I can't afford to
fail my
make-up exam!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Let me know if you need more. I could
fetch you
another slice or three!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Hey, Teach! Glad you asked!
choice_data_list: 追試とケーキって関係あるの？

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Sugar gets your mind racing, right? With
this
much energy, I'm bound to pass the
test!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Sugar gets your mind racing, right? With
this
much energy, I'm bound to pass the
test!
choice_data_list: 食べ過ぎると逆効果じゃない？
いっぱい食べてテスト頑張れ！
いっぱい食べてテスト頑張って！

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I dunno, but sweets are like fuel for your
brain,
right?
choice_data_list: 食べ過ぎると逆効果じゃない？
いっぱい食べてテスト頑張れ！
いっぱい食べてテスト頑張って！

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
The way I see it, more power means
more
thinking. Right, Fuji?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I agree—the more fuel, the better.
Although I
suppose eating too much
might send you into a
food coma.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Fuji... You're just egging me on for
giggles, aren't
you?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Of course not! I believe you capable of
surpassing
any tribulations that may
come your way, be it
drowsiness or a
make-up exam!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... You'd be the one to know,
Teach, so I'll
lay off the cake for now.
choice_data_list: 何事もほどほどが1番だ
何事もほどほどが1番だよ

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Well! You sure trust your trainer's
judgment a lot.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, trust comes naturally when we're
workin' as
a team.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Here, you can have this last slice, Teach!

Having properly moderated her sugar
intake,
Hishi Amazon goes off to
conquer her make-up
exam with gusto.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I've got this! History,
math—they're all
going down!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
That's the spirit! I'll go get more cake for
you.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Actually, you know what? I'll just grab
an entire
cake! ♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Bring it on! I'll stuff myself full and make
quick
work of my exam!

Hishi Amazon crams her notes while
scarfing down
the cake, then heads off
to face her exam...
